claude.sample_unit: spelling rounds (across three public P300 datasets)

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM-assisted decoding versus simpler static-vocabulary and unconstrained decoding on same data
links.effect: Static vocabulary 48.1% vs 30.6% unconstrained on BigP3BCI (p = 0.001, dz = 1.24); LLM-assisted mode did not beat unconstrained (SV > UC ≥ LLM in all three datasets).
links.quote: Current small LLMs (Qwen2.5 1.5B, GPT-2) operate below both necessary conditions in all three datasets, explaining the consistent ordering SV > UC ≥ LLM.

unlisted_practices: Derive and measure breakeven recall and candidate quality thresholds to decide whether LLM candidate-set narrowing should be used in P300 BCIs

links.outcome: LLM-assisted decoding accuracy versus simpler decoding modes
links.effect: Across three datasets, Qwen2.5 1.5B and GPT-2 were below both conditions; ordering was SV > UC ≥ LLM.
links.quote: Current small LLMs (Qwen2.5 1.5B, GPT-2) operate below both necessary conditions in all three datasets, explaining the consistent ordering SV > UC ≥ LLM.

unlisted_practices: Breakeven recall framework requiring candidate quality (p_hit > p_UC) and recall sufficiency (R > R∗UC) before LLM-P300 candidate-set narrowing.

links.outcome: P300 decoding accuracy of LLM compared to simpler alternatives
links.effect: Static vocabulary (48.1%) > unconstrained (30.6%) > LLM (24.4% observed) on BigP3BCI (p = 0.001), with consistent ordering SV > UC >= LLM across all three datasets
links.quote: Current small LLMs (Qwen2.5 1.5B, GPT-2) operate below both necessary conditions in all three datasets, explaining the consistent ordering SV > UC ≥ LLM.

unlisted_practices: Pre-decision candidate-set narrowing calibrated by recall sufficiency and candidate quality thresholds

screen.practice: static vocabulary restriction vs LLM candidate-set narrowing with recall threshold criteria
screen.reason: Evaluates LLM integration into assistive P300 brain-computer interface spellers for motor-impaired patients, testing an analytical calibration threshold (breakeven recall framework) for when to employ LLM candidate narrowing vs unconstrained decoding.
